headline: NSE Promotes Electronic Gold Receipts to Reduce India's Import Costs
summary: The National Stock Exchange of India encouraged investors to buy Electronic Gold Receipts, targeting $5–$6 billion in annual import savings by formalizing household bullion holdings into financial markets.
why: India is the world's second-largest gold consumer; shifting physical gold demand to electronic receipts reduces national trade account deficits.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Formalizing domestic gold assets via electronic receipts aims to trim physical gold imports.
